Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1200
Claimant:
Eric Harrington
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
12 Dec 2023
First notice of loss received for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection involving the insured vehicle and a
second vehicle. The claimant reports a back strain and is represetned by counsel, who has asked that all
communication be routed through their office.
18 Dec 2023
Reviewed the police report, which records the collision as described and places the claimant in the vehicle at the
time. The responding officer noted the points of impact on both vehicles.
29 Dec 2023
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses and the other driver. Each account matches the claimant's
description of how the crash happened, including the direction of travel and the signal phase.
28 Mar 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed representation and provided a medical authorization. The claimant
has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so far.
21 Apr 2024
Inspected the insured vehicle and reviewed scene photographs. The damage to the driver's side and door panel lines
up well with the impact described, and no older damage has been identified.
6 May 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of
coverage.
17 May 2024
Reviewed the claimant's medical records. The reported back strain fits the kind and force of a side impact of this type.
No prior injury to the same area appears in the records or in the claimant's history.
20 May 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, beginning with urgent care, then physical therapy. Visits have tapered as the
claimant's symptoms improved, and the provider's notes reflect steady progress.
29 May 2024
Requested updated treatment notes from the provider to confirm current status. Reviewed the file with the counsel's
office to make sure all requested documents are in hand.
23 Jun 2024
Compared the vehicle repair estimate against the inspection findings. The line items correspond to the damage areas
documented at the scene, and no unrelated repairs are included.
3 Jul 2024
Based on the current file, the claim is moving forward on the normal timeline. Next step is to review the updated
treatmnet notes once received and finalize the evaluation with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
